ignore.input_l2_axis: autoconfig key built at run time: "input" + bind name "l2" (DECLARE_BIND table) + "_axis" (configuration.c save_keybind_axis)
ignore.input_r2_axis: autoconfig key built at run time: "input" + bind name "r2" (DECLARE_BIND table) + "_axis" (configuration.c save_keybind_axis)
ignore.armn64_resolution: armN64's own core option (its libretro/libretro.c option table), written to the core's .opt: RetroArch's source holds no core's keys
